Site Reliability Engineer, Trading Platform
Nexa Digital Assets — Remote (EU / US)

About Nexa
Nexa Digital Assets is a crypto exchange and custodial platform serving institutional clients. Our R&D team ships order books, wallets and on-chain settlement in a fast-moving, go-to-market driven environment. We are led by a C-suite with deep traditional finance experience and we care about craft over process.

What you'll do
- Own reliability of our matching engine, market data feeds and internal trading APIs.
- Operate multi-region Kubernetes clusters on AWS and bare metal colocation sites.
- Build observability with Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry; define SLOs and error budgets.
- Lead incident response, write postmortems and maintain runbooks and on-call rotations (24/7).
- Automate infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible; improve CI/CD pipelines.
- Run Ethereum execution clients, beacon nodes and RPC infrastructure for our settlement layer.

Requirements
- 5+ years of SRE, production engineering or platform engineering experience
- Deep Kubernetes and Docker experience running production workloads
- Strong Linux fundamentals and TCP/IP networking (DNS, load balancing, Nginx)
- Terraform, Ansible and infrastructure as code on AWS
- Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing
- Experience with incident management, on-call and postmortem culture
- Python or Go for tooling and automation
- Hands-on with Ethereum validator nodes, staking and archive node operations

Nice to have
- Rust
- Solana validator operations
- MEV and low latency trading infrastructure
- HSM, Fireblocks or custody integrations

Benefits
- Competitive compensation, remote-first culture and annual offsites
- Learning budget for certifications and conferences
- Four weeks of paid time off plus local public holidays

Nexa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
